In the northern wilds of Sol’Kesh, high amongst the colossal conifers of Last Bloom, the calitross silently climbs. Th is avian creature, 
having long lost its ability to fly, uses its long limbs to quietly stalk the boughs and cliff crags instead, gathering berries, and if lucky, 
scavenging recent kills. Surviving in the harsh northern climate has made this versatile omnivore one of the more intelligent creatures 
in Sol’Kesh, living in small flocks of a dozen family members they have a developed rich vocabulary of chirps, cries and bird song to 
warn each other of incoming predators, like the basilospri and lexati. Together the flock can distract larger predators to scavenge from 
their kill, create communal stores of nuts for the colder seasons, and protect their terrestrial fledglings for the next generation.
Class - Aves • Genus Derived Evolution - Tyto • Niche - Generalist Omnivore Arboreal Scavenger 
Preyed upon by - Basilospri, Lexati, Skyelarx, Vinnirex,Ynnil • Preys on - Burberry Beetles, Dartiguan, Lhoupin

Encountering Quietly climbing overhead in the heights of 
conifers trees, fi nding a calitross is no easy feat and with superb 
eyesight and hearing, they can often sense approaching danger. 
One method to lure them is out to hang freshly killed carcasses 
over high branches. Although the avian creatures are often 
smart enough to suspect something, the allure of an easy meal 
can override their suspicion.
